card.description:
**Grow boldly with Pretium and Lead a High-Performing Manufacturing Operation and Drive Operational Excellence!**

Are you a proven manufacturing leader with a passion for developing teams, improving performance, and delivering exceptional results? **Pretium Packaging** is seeking an experienced **Plant Manager** in **Salt Lake City, Utah** to lead our manufacturing facility and take ownership of safety, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and profitability.

This is a highly visible leadership role with full responsibility for plant operations, financial performance, and continuous improvement initiatives. If you thrive in a **fast-paced manufacturing environment** and enjoy building high-performing teams while driving operational excellence, we'd like to hear from you.

**Who We Are:**

Pretium Packaging, founded in 1992, is a leading supplier of injection-blow molded plastic containers, known for delivering superior quality, value, and customer service. With 21 manufacturing locations across North America, we provide innovative, high-performance packaging solutions to a diverse portfolio of brand owners in the U.S. and Canada.

**What You'll Do**

As Plant Manager, you will oversee all aspects of plant operations, including production, quality, maintenance, materials management, warehousing, and shipping. You will provide strategic leadership to the site while ensuring the safe, efficient, and profitable operation of the facility.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a cross-functional leadership team including Production, Quality, Process Engineering, Maintenance, and Shipping.
* Drive a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
* Manage all plant operations to ensure customer orders are produced and shipped on time while meeting quality standards.
* Own plant financial performance with full P&L responsibility, including budgeting, cost control, and profitability improvement initiatives.
* Develop staffing, production, scheduling, and material plans to support business objectives.
* Monitor production performance and proactively resolve operational challenges related to equipment, materials, tooling, and processes.
* Lead Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
* Establish and implement operating procedures, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and results.
* Evaluate and recommend capital investments, equipment upgrades, and process improvements.
* Collaborate with commercial, engineering, and product development teams to support new products and customer growth opportunities.
* Maintain compliance with OSHA, EPA, ISO, GMP, and all applicable regulatory requirements.
* Build strong relationships with customers and ensure a customer-focused approach throughout the organization.
* Partner closely with Human Resources on talent development, employee engagement, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead plant meetings and communication efforts related to safety, quality, maintenance, production, and continuous improvement.

**What We're Looking For:**

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7–10+ years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience leading large teams in a manufacturing environment.
* Strong understanding of production operations, quality systems, maintenance, materials management, and supply chain processes.
* Proven experience managing budgets, controlling costs, and driving operational profitability.
* Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
* Ability to travel as needed.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Business, or a related field.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within the plastics, packaging, or related manufacturing industries.
* Experience with Oracle or other ERP systems.
* Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Six Sigma, or similar operational excellence experience.
* Experience in ISO and GMP-regulated environments.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

You are a hands-on leader who can balance strategic thinking with daily operational execution. You know how to develop people, solve complex manufacturing challenges, and create a culture where safety, quality, and performance thrive.

**What You'll Bring:**

* Exceptional leadership and team-building skills
* Strong financial and business acumen
* Excellent communication and influencing abilities
* Data-driven decision-making capabilities
* A passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence
* A customer-first mindset
* The ability to lead through change and deliver results

**Why Join Pretium?**

At Pretium Packaging, we manufacture rigid plastic containers for some of the most recognized brands in the marketplace. Our plants operate with a strong emphasis on safety, performance, and continuous improvement.

This is an opportunity to step into a leadership role where your impact will be visible, measurable, and valued***. If you’re energized by continuous improvement, team development, and running a plant like it’s your own business — we want to talk with you.***

Equal Opportunity Employer

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
The Plant Superintendent has a primary focus on driving, guiding and influencing the support mechanisms of streamlining and coordinating the overall operational effectiveness and efficiency of the assigned operations. The Plant Superintendent focuses specifically on: overall Health & Safety and Environmental compliance; quality control; maintenance and accuracy of all material inventories; coordination of inter-yard transportation of materials; ensuring volume quotas are being met by communicating with the Commercial Group; and Continuous Improvement for the facilities, administration, and management of Production and Maintenance Superintendents and Supervisors. The Plant Superintendent reports directly to the General Manager.

This position operates within flexible parameters. The primary goal of this position is to achieve excellence in all facets of facility management. Providing the highest quality product safely, effectively and efficiently decreases accidents and errors and increases profits.

**Essential Functions:**

Environmental and Health & Safety (H&S)

* Supports overall H&S issues within the facility by working closely with the Regional Safety Engineer(s). Ensures Environmental compliance in accordance with company, federal and state policies by working closely with the Regional Environmental Superintendent.
* Provides a safe environment for all employees, customers and visitors.
* Monitors H&S programs administered by MRB H&S department.
* Following an incident or accident, instructs personnel on Corrective Action Plans in accordance with policy.
* Monitors H&S and Environmental Compliance for all assigned locations to report any deficiencies and/or issues to the Regional General Superintendent, General Superintendent, H&S Engineer(s), and/or Environmental Superintendent.

Operational Performance & Best Management Practices

* Investigates to clarify, validate, test and analyze operational data for accuracy and validity.
* Oversees operations and maintenance in all departments.
* Reviews maintenance procedures and record keeping for all production equipment.
* Forecasts monthly production with Department Superintendents, in conjunction with the Commercial group, to ensure facility goals are met.
* Ensures that negotiated production levels are met and maintained for all departments.
* Assesses the effectiveness of transportation and other sub-contractors.
* Spearheads Continuous Improvement for the facility.

Equipment & Maintenance

* Monitors equipment needs and availability for the facility

Inventory & Quality Control

* Maintains communication with facility and regional Commercial and Transportation Departments to ensure material purchase quotas are being met for the facilities and material is being transferred or shipped in a timely fashion.
* Maintains accurate material inventories in all facilities, keeping in compliance with all internal and SOX controls, in conjunction with the regional financial group.
* Monitors assigned yard inventories.
* Ensures that reports of any off grade/ off spec materials are discussed with supervisor prior to shipment in order to eliminate quality consumer complaints, avoid downgrades, and eliminate claims
* Ensures all storage of finished goods is done in compliance with internal controls already set in place.
* Implements and maintains an effective, documented Quality Control program focusing on a strong relationship with Commercial and Sales departments.
* Works with internal and customer specs for materials.

Budgeting & Forecasting

* Operates facilities within established Operating and CAPEX budgets and makes recommendations on a yearly basis for Capital Expenditures taking into account: equipment condition; environmental necessities; operational needs; ability to sustain business operations; business growth.

Administrative Management

* Identifies and spearheads any necessary training for all personnel.
* Ensures proper reporting is in place and being utilized for all production departments.
* Manages all personnel by setting up an appropriate management structure.
* Follows HR guidelines for status changes, salary changes, goal setting, annual reviews/evaluations, and payroll issues.

Special Projects

* Performs other special projects as assigned.

**Internal Control Responsibilities:**

Supports the Company’s Internal Control process which includes understanding, communicating and complying with defined internal controls as well as suggesting and making modifications to the policies, procedures and controls to better relate to the business.

Communicates upward problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, or other policy violations or illegal actions.

**Interpersonal Contacts:**

Internal contacts are by phone and in person with Metals Recycling Business personnel and various management level personnel. External contacts are by phone, e-mail and in person with potential and existing customers, other companies within the industry, and governmental agencies.

**Job Conditions:**

Workload is cyclical and can present significant time pressures when strict adherence to deadlines is critical. Workload is often reactive and cannot be anticipated or planned for. Often many extra hours are required, weekend, weekday and holidays. Exposure to physical operations at metal recycling yards; it is necessary to walk/climb in active industrial yards with uneven surfaces and to out-of-the-way areas.

Occasional exposure to inclement weather conditions and travel is required. Work pressure can be substantial during peak times, requiring considerable adaptability; disturbances of work flow, and/or irregularities in work schedule are expected and occur on an intermittent basis. Regular overtime is required. Offsite work involves meeting in person with current or potential customers, and visiting other Radius locations.

**Physical Activities Required to Perform Essential Functions:**

Ability to: sit or stand for extended periods of time, up to 6 hours per day. Position requires individual to: stand, walk, and/or otherwise move around a steel scrap yard environment. Some computer work is necessary requiring visual acuity to perform close detail work. Must have the ability to communicate in a professional manner by phone, e-mail and in person with all levels of internal personnel and business contacts.

**Qualifications:**

Minimum of 5-10 years previous experience in steel scrap yard operations, and familiarity with physical operations and personnel. College degree preferred; courses in business/operations management helpful. Project management experience or specialized knowledge a plus. This position requires possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive an automobile.

Knowledge of operations; leadership, analytical, organization, good communication, good mathematical skills; and intermediate computer competency. Ability to: apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of practical problems; deal with a large number of variables and determine a specific course of action.

**PLEASE NOTE: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required.**

All U.S. applicants must be 18 years of age or older and all Canada applicants must be 16 years of age or older.

Radius Recycling participates in e-verify for all U.S. new hires.

An offer of U.S. employment by Radius Recycling or any of its subsidiaries is contingent on the satisfactory completion of a post-offer drug screen and background check.

All new hires must review and sign an Arbitration Agreement. This applies to all U.S. non-union employees.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Radius Recycling does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, marital status, disability status, national origin or ancestry, veteran status, age, prior industrial injury, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other protected status under local, state or federal law.

card.title: Multi-Site Plant Manager
card.description:
### **Description**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled **Plant Manager** to oversee and manage all aspects of multi-site plant operations, ensuring efficient production, high-quality standards, and a safe working environment. 
 
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, proven experience in managing manufacturing plants, and a thorough understanding of operational strategies, including safety, budgeting, and human resource management. The Plant Manager will also be responsible for ensuring production goals are met, maintaining plant facilities, and continuously improving processes to maximize efficiency

### **How You Will Help**

 

* Lead and manage daily operations of the manufacturing plant to meet production schedules, ensure product quality, and achieve on-time delivery.
* Partner with EHS to ensure safety, health, and environmental regulations, including local, state, and federal safety standards.
* Develop and implement strategic plans for operational efficiency, resource allocation, and process improvements.
* Manage plant budgets and financial statements, ensuring cost-effective operations while meeting financial goals.
* Maintain and upgrade plant facilities and equipment, ensuring they are in optimal working condition; oversee necessary repairs, replacements, and adjustments.
* Monitor production activities, ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols, including the use of personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to optimize production processes and implement lean manufacturing principles.
* Create and foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, leading by example and building strong relationships with team members.
* Implement and monitor inventory management strategies, ensuring proper material flow and minimizing waste.
* Develop, mentor, and manage staff, providing training and development opportunities to enhance skills and performance.
* Ensure timely communication and coordination between departments to meet production targets and business objectives.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, making data-driven decisions to improve plant efficiency and productivity.
* Perform other duties as assigned by senior management
* Travel up to 10% domestically, including quarterly visits to company facilities in Pennsylvania and Texas to support project execution and cross-functional collaboration.

 

### **What You Will Bring**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience working in a custom manufacturing environment, including knowledge of assembly, fabrication, welding, and machining processes
* A minimum of 10 years of experience in plant operations, with at least 5 years in a management role.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, strategic planning, and financial statements.
* Strong leadership abilities with proven experience in team building, decision-making, and people management.
* In-depth knowledge of manufacturing processes, equipment, and safety standards.
* Familiarity with lean manufacturing, supply chain management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA or advanced degree in a related field.
* Certification or experience with lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, or supply chain management.
* Working knowledge of industry codes and standards, including TOSHA and other health and safety regulations.

 

### **About Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation**

Bringing together more than 175 years of innovation, quality, and customer commitment under one name and one promise.

The company was forged in 1850, as American industry was being connected by pipe, valves, fittings, and the skilled people who knew how to put them in the right place. More than 175 years later, that heritage lives in ASC Engineered Solutions, a comprehensive pipe preparation, joining, hanging and flow-management portfolio supporting the people who build and maintain commercial buildings, industrial facilities, infrastructure, and critical systems. A house of brands, Anvil, Gruvlok, Sharpe, SCI, and ABZ, unified as ASC in 2019, and the portfolio has grown in the years since.

In 1920, Reliable Automatic Sprinkler started doing one thing exceptionally well: building the fire safety systems that protect people and property. Sprinklers, valves, and accessories, made in the United States. More than a century later, the discipline has not changed. A century of American-made fire protection products, with multi-generational customer relationships and multi-decade specifications. A century of protecting what matters the most.

**Two legacies. One Future.**

\*Reliable Safety and Flow Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.\*

card.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Operations (3rd Shift)
card.description:
Job Description 
 General Summary: 
 The Senior Manager, Manufacturing Operations manages a supervisory team and provides oversight to the day-to-day operations.
 This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure safe, compliant, and efficient execution of cGMP manufacturing operations in alignment with production schedules, site objectives, and business priorities. The Senior Manager is accountable for maintaining an audit-ready facility, driving continuous improvement, building organizational capability, and supporting the successful production of pharmaceutical drug products.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Manage and develop a supervisory team, ensuring strong execution, accountability, and team effectiveness.
 Direct the activities of the group through management of staff, prioritization, and assignment of tasks.
 Responsible for aligning with site leadership to provide departmental and technical leadership.
 Assume a project leader role for departmental and interdisciplinary projects.
 Ensure work is prioritized, staffed, and executed in alignment with detailed production schedules and business needs.
 Oversee cGMP manufacturing activities, including equipment setup, assembly, operation, disassembly, cleaning, and associated support activities.
 Ensure compliant execution, review, and approval of batch documentation and other GMP records.
 Provide oversight for real-time on-the-floor batch record review and escalation of operational or compliance issues as needed.
 Participate in event investigations, CAPAs, and change controls in support of production and departmental objectives.
 Identify and continuously improve practices, procedures, and activities related to the department and site.
 Partner cross-functionally to support validation activities, facility readiness, investigations, and manufacturing objectives.
 Ensure the facility remains in an audit-ready state through adherence to procedures, documentation standards, and inspection readiness practices.
 Monitor and enforce GMP compliance for personnel, processes, and activities.
 Drive operational performance through tiered management systems, including leadership of Tier 1 and/or Tier 2 meetings and follow-up on escalated issues.
 Monitor manufacturing performance metrics and trends; identify risks and drive actions to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost.
 Enable the timely achievement of departmental, site, and corporate goals.
 Mentor, motivate, coach, and evaluate the performance of group members.
 Foster interdisciplinary communication, collaboration, and shared understanding within the group and across departments.
 Ensure personal and team compliance with all training requirements.
 Demonstrate the Vertex Phenotype behaviors: Lead by Example; Learn, Teach & Develop; Foster Exceptional Collaboration; Drive Breakthrough Results; and Promote Enterprise Thinking.
 Perform other duties and projects as assigned to meet departmental and business requirements.
 
 Knowledge and Skills: 
 Advanced interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
 Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to lead through others and build high-performing teams.
 Demonstrated ability to mentor and develop supervisors and emerging leaders.
 Strong organizational, planning, and operational management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple activities.
 Deep knowledge of cGMP principles and associated regulatory expectations in a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment.
 Strong understanding of cell therapy manufacturing operations, including process execution, equipment operation, and facility support requirements.
 Demonstrated competency in process, equipment, and facility validation experience.
 Experience with event investigations, deviation management, CAPA, change control, and inspection readiness.
 Proficiency with Quality by Design (QbD) concepts, Design of Experiments (DoE), statistical process control (SPC), and complex data analysis.
 Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess operational risk, escalate appropriately, and drive resolution.
 Ability to improve systems, processes, and team performance through continuous improvement principles.
 Ability to clearly communicate technical and operational rationale for procedures, practices, and manufacturing approaches.
 Proficiency with manufacturing systems and documentation platforms, including QDoCCS and other GMP systems.
 
 Education and Experience: 
 Bachelor’s degree required in a scientific, technical, or engineering discipline.
 Typically requires 10+ years of experience or the equivalent combination of education and experience.
 Strong experience in direct people supervision in a cGMP manufacturing environment required.
 Significant leadership experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations within a cGMP-regulated environment required.
 Prior experience managing supervisors and/or manufacturing teams.
 Prior cell therapy and aseptic manufacturing experience.
 Prior POMS MES experience preferred.
 Experience supporting commercial and/or late-stage development manufacturing preferred.
 

 Work Schedule 
 This position supports our overnight operations. Availability to work other shifts may be necessary to support onboarding, training, and critical manufacturing activities.

 New hires will complete an approximately 90-day training program on either first shift or second shift before transitioning to the assigned overnight schedule. Training will take place between our Cambridge Facility: 100 Tech Drive, and Leiden Center 1 (LC1) in Seaport.

 The training period will run through January / February 2027, with 5x8hr shifts: Sun - Thurs OR Tues- Saturday 7am - 3:30pm. OR Tuesday - Saturday 2:30pm -11pm
 
 The ongoing work shift thereafter will be 4x10hr shifts: Sunday - Wed 9pm -7:30am OR Wed - Saturday 9pm - 7:30am 
 

 3rd shift employees are entitled to 20% pay differential 

 Please note that work schedules are based on business needs and may be adjusted or modified as operational requirements evolve. Candidates must be flexible and able to accommodate schedule changes, including shifts, assigned days or hours, as determined by Vertex.

We seek talent who bring an external perspective, demonstrate curiosity and sound judgment, and thoughtfully adopt new capabilities that improve decision-making, drive innovation, increase efficiency, and help deliver better outcomes for patients.

$139,100 - $208,700 
 Disclosure Statement: 
 The range provided is based on what we believe is a reasonable estimate for the base salary pay range for this job at the time of posting. This role is eligible for an annual bonus and annual equity awards. Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay, in accordance with federal and state requirements. Actual base salary pay will be based on a number of factors, including skills, competencies, experience, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

card.title: Director of S&OP and Production Continuous Improvement
card.description:
At Taconic Biosciences, operational excellence fuels scientific discovery. We're seeking an experienced Operations Planning leader to strengthen the connection between commercial demand and operational execution, ensuring our teams deliver exceptional results for customers worldwide. If you're passionate about strategic planning, continuous improvement, and leading high-performing teams, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

**The Location:** This role is a primarily at home/remote but will have ad hoc needs to come onsite. Average monthly time on-site is 5% - 10%. A candidate residing within 2 hours of Albany, NY or Germantown, NY is preferred but not required.

**The Pay Range**: $120,000 - $170,000 annually. *Exact annual base salary may vary based on several factors. These factors include, but are not limited to: geographic location, experience, training, education, and local market conditions.*

**The Schedule:** Monday - Friday, core business hours.

**What we offer:**

* Insurance within 30 days or less which includes options for medical, dental, vision, pet insurance and more!
* 20 days paid time off plus 6 additional holidays and 1 floating holiday
* Work life balance
* 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Career advancement opportunities
* Commitment to training and providing you with the skills you need for success
* All employees receive access to 24/7 telemedicine (including mental health), short- and long-term disability and life insurance

**The Role:** 
The role's objective is to strengthen alignment between Operations and the Commercial areas, making sure internal and external customers' expectations are met, as well as constantly improving efficiency & cost to achieve business financial commitments. 
 
**Core Responsibilities:**

* Manage and develop the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process across the business
* Ensure optimal communication among Commercial & Operations regarding demand and production commitments
* Develop and maintain updated Operational Capacity numbers, and timely detect capacity expansion needs
* Coordinator efforts to develop Operation's yearly budgets (AOP) and forecast updates
* Work closely with global Commercial Demand stakeholders (sales, marketing, R&D), Procurement, Animal Production and Logistics to align Operation's resources to demand
* Identify and highlight to OLT (Operations Leadership Team) any short-, mid-, and long-term resource needs based on commercial demand plans and changes
* Develop a LEAN Production culture that is constantly looking for improvement results in all metrics that matter considering, but not limited to: People, Safety, Quality, Animal Welfare, Customer Services and Cost
* Detect, develop and execute continuous improvement projects to optimize the use of Operation's resources; (5Ms - Men & Women, Machines, Materials, Minutes (time and schedules), Methods)
* Develop and implement success metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement
* Lead, manage and develop all members of the Operations Planning Team

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering or similar required, Master's degree is desirable
* Experience in the management of a professional staff and senior-level decision making
* Extensive experience in a specialized field, with responsibility for strategic technical direction, high-impact problem-solving, or enterprise-level initiatives
* 10+ years of relevant experience and/or training required
* Experience in Industrial Production/Manufacturing. Laboratory animal production would be desirable.
* Skill in designing, implementing, and coordinating projects.
* Experience in making strategic decisions or recommendations for improving or changing organizational policies, procedures and processes.
* Structured, well organized analytical thinking.
* 10+ years in any area of Industrial Operations areas.
* 6+ years in Production / Manufacturing
* 5+ years leading teams & experience in Change Management
* 3+ years in S&OP process including IBP (Integrated Business Planning) 
 Other Desirable Experience & Competencies:
* 3+ years managing Operations / Manufacturing Costs
* 3+ Years Project management experience (PMO)
* Knowledge and Practical experience with Forecasting Statistical Methodologies
* APICS certification
* AI experienced applied to S&OP
* Multi site / Global responsibility.

**Allergen Disclosure:**

Due to the nature of the work performed at Taconic, employees may be exposed to allergens in the workplace, even if their positions do not involve the direct handling of animals or animal bedding. While individuals with preexisting allergies and/or asthma may be particularly sensitive to these exposures, anyone can experience a reaction.

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment:**

The work is sedentary. Typically, the employee may sit comfortably to do the work, with some walking; standing; bending; carrying of items such as papers, books, small parts; driving an automobile; etc. No special physical demands are required to perform the work.

**About Us:** 
With a history of over 70 years of excellence, Taconic Biosciences is a global team of the best problem solvers in the industry. We partner with our clients to develop winning research strategies that accelerate the discoveries for prevention and treatment of disease.

Taconic employees all over the world show up every day to deliver the best solutions for our clients while caring for ourselves, each other, and especially our animals. If you are a respectful, compassionate individual with a can-do attitude and a desire to do the right thing, we want you to join us!

**Better Together at Taconic** 
Awareness, Action, & Respect. Taconic Biosciences is taking an active and intentional role in fostering a company culture that values and appreciates the uniqueness of all individuals, by promoting fairness and equity. Being you is what allows you to bring your best self to work. We are committed to making Taconic a safe and fair workplace for everyone. We are better together. 
 
Taconic Biosciences is an equal-opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, and all other categories protected by law.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**Role Summary**

Parklane is opening a brand-new manufacturing facility in Michigan, and we are looking for a Plant Manager to work with us to build it from the ground up. As the senior leader on site, you will have accountability for the plant: safety, quality, delivery, cost, people, and culture. You will lead a team of up to 150 employees and be supported by Parklane’s shared services groups, including Engineering, Supply Chain, Human Resources, and Finance, so you can focus on running a safe, high-performing operation and setting the standard for how Parklane operates in Michigan.

**Key Responsibilities**

Site Leadership & Start-Up

* Own the overall performance of the Michigan facility, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, and cost
* Lead the ramp-up of the new site, establishing operating rhythms, processes, and standards aligned with Parklane’s practices
* Develop and execute site plans and budgets in partnership with Finance and senior leadership
* Serve as the face of Parklane in the local community, with customers, vendors, and regulators

Operations & Production

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, and shipping activities to meet customer commitments
* Work with production scheduling and Supply Chain to balance capacity, labor, and material availability
* Drive continuous improvement and lean practices to improve throughput, reduce waste, and control cost
* Track and report on site KPIs, and act quickly on gaps to plan

Safety, Quality & Compliance

* Champion a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements
* Partner with QHSE to implement and sustain Parklane’s quality management system and drive corrective actions to closure
* Maintain a clean, organized, audit-ready facility and well-maintained equipment

People Leadership

* Recruit, develop, and lead plant leaders, supervisors, and front-line teams, building a strong bench for a growing site
* Partner with Human Resources on hiring, onboarding, employee relations, performance management, and engagement
* Set clear expectations, coach for accountability, and recognize results in line with Parklane’s core values
* Build a positive, inclusive culture where employees feel safe, respected, and invested in the site’s success

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Engineering on product design, manufacturability, and technical issues
* Partner with Supply Chain on procurement, inventory, logistics, and supplier performance
* Collaborate with Finance on budgeting, cost control, and financial reporting
* Leverage shared services across the organization to support the site efficiently, and provide feedback to continuously improve that support

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* 8+ years of progressive manufacturing operations experience, including 3+ years in a plant management or senior site leadership role
* Proven experience leading a workforce of 100+ in a manufacturing or fabrication environment
* Experience launching, expanding, or transforming a facility is a strong asset
* Strong working knowledge of lean manufacturing, continuous improvement, and quality systems (ISO 9001 exposure preferred)
* Solid understanding of OSHA and workplace safety, environmental, and employment regulations in the U.S.
* Financial acumen, including budgeting, P&L awareness, and cost management
* Experience with ERP systems and data-driven performance management (D365 an asset)
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to influence across a matrixed organization
* Hands-on, accountable, and comfortable building structure in a fast-paced, evolving environment

**About Parklane**

As one of North America’s leading providers of turnkey mechanical noise control and VIRS solutions, Parklane is on a constant search for top industry talent. Every day we help clients with their sound attenuation and vibration challenges. We do it by leveraging an agile approach to engineering, product manufacturing and implementation.

As an organization, we live and breathe our core values:

1. Challenge Accepted

2. Work Hard & Play Hard

3. Share the Wins & Own the Losses, and

4. Build Together, Grow Together

By sharing ideas and supporting each other at every turn, we’ve built a reputation both for service excellence and the strength of our workplace culture. Put simply, our team is committed to doing whatever it takes to help our customers succeed—and that’s why we need professionals with the experience and expertise to solve complex problems.

Pay: $125,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food manufacturing, team leadership, and continuous improvement practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee all aspects of food production operations, including planning, staffing, scheduling, equipment, and workflow.
* Ensure compliance with food safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies.
* Lead, coach, and develop production supervisors and line staff to ensure high performance and accountability.
* Monitor production KPIs (yields, throughput, downtime, labor efficiency, waste) and implement corrective actions as needed.
* Collaborate with departments such as Quality Assurance, Maintenance, Procurement, and Logistics to ensure smooth operations.
* Analyze production data and identify areas for cost reduction, process improvement, and operational efficiency.
* Manage staffing levels to meet production demand while controlling labor costs.
* Lead or support continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies.
* Ensure proper maintenance and safe operation of production equipment.
* Enforce a culture of safety, cleanliness, and food compliance throughout the facility.
* Additional activities as assigned.

**Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in a food production or manufacturing environment, with at least 2 years in a leadership or management role.
* Strong knowledge of food safety regulations, HACCP, GMPs, and related compliance standards.
* Proven leadership and team development abilities.
* Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Proficient in production planning software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle), and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies is a plus.

**1. Leadership & People Management**

* Ability to lead, motivate, and develop high-performing teams.
* Skilled in managing conflict, delegating tasks, and fostering a culture of accountability.
* Effective at coaching supervisors and line staff to meet goals.

**2. Operational Excellence**

* Strong grasp of manufacturing processes, including batching, cooking, packaging, and sanitation.
* Proficient in using KPIs to track and improve production performance (yield, OEE, waste, etc.).
* Competency in Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.

**3. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* In-depth knowledge of HACCP, GMPs, FDA/USDA regulations, and third-party audit standards.
* Able to ensure compliance while maintaining efficient production flow.

**4. Planning & Organization**

* Capable of managing production schedules, labor allocation, and resource planning effectively.
* Strong prioritization skills in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills across all levels of the organization.

* Rapidly identifies root causes of operational issues and implements effective solutions.
* Makes sound, data-driven decisions under pressure.

**7. Technical Proficiency**

* Proficient in ERP and production management systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
* Comfortable with Microsoft Excel and production reporting tools.

**8. Quality Focus**

* Maintains a strong commitment to producing safe, high-quality food products.
* Ensures production meets internal and customer standards for consistency and specification.

**9. Safety & Risk Management**

* Promotes a culture of safety and enforces all workplace safety procedures.
* Proactively identifies risks and implements mitigation strategies.

* Thrives in a dynamic production environment with changing demands.
* Maintains composure and performance under stress or operational setbacks.

card.title: Plant Manager
card.description:
**Job Overview**

The Plant Manager is responsible for directing and coordinating the daily operations of the chrome plating facility and develops efficiency strategies to meet plant goals while minimizing production costs. The Plant Manager is also responsible for upholding a safe work environment, adherence to policy and procedure, and maintaining optimal operational efficiency. As the Plant Manager of a chrome plating facility, you must possess working knowledge of all chrome plating operations, including but not limited to: plating line operations, tank chemistry and maintenance, chemical handling and safety procedures, wastewater treatment and environmental compliance, equipment operation (hoists, diaphragm pumps, filter press, sludge dryer), and quality control standards specific to chrome plating. The Plant Manager must understand the complete production workflow from material receipt through finishing to ensure efficient, safe, and compliant operations. While departmental specialists will handle day-to-day execution of specialized tasks, the Plant Manager must be familiar with all aspects of the operation to effectively oversee the facility, troubleshoot issues, coordinate with department managers, and make informed decisions regarding resource allocation and process improvements.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct and coordinate daily chrome plating facility operations
* Ability to lead operations in an effective manner
* Develop and implement efficiency strategies to optimize production while minimizing costs
* Create, manage, and adjust production schedules based on manufacturing needs and resource availability
* Monitor all equipment and machinery to ensure proper functioning and maintenance standards
* Oversee quality control and inspection procedures to verify that products meet specified quality standards
* Demonstrate understanding of customer-specified quality standards and rejection procedures
* Direct relations with customers & understand their needs.
* Properly handle and package finished products per customer requirements
* Accurately identify and manage customer materials throughout the production process
* Maintain all tools and equipment in proper working order; coordinate maintenance activities
* Effectively communicate departmental supply needs and resource requirements to appropriate personnel
* Oversee and collaborate with all departmental managers to ensure all aspects of operations run efficiently and effectively
* Host regular meetings with departmental managers to resolve issues and ensure efficient, balanced, and cost-effective workflow
* Keep work areas clean, organized, and compliant with safety standards
* Use proper personal protective wear and equipment; ensure all employees do the same
* Possess working knowledge of all appropriate statutes and regulations governing the facility, including environmental and safety regulations specific to chrome plating operations
* Report any unsafe or potentially hazardous conditions immediately
* Maintain compliance with all company policies and procedures

**Responsibilites / Skills**

* Comprehensive understanding of chrome plating processes and operations
* Knowledge of chrome plating chemistry, tank maintenance, and quality standards
* Understanding of equipment operation specific to chrome plating facilities (hoists, pumps, filter press, etc.)
* General mechanical awareness in operating automated equipment
* Ability to perform multi-tasked operations and manage competing priorities
* Strong communication skills—both written and verbal
* Leadership and team management capabilities
* Understanding of appropriate statutes and regulations applicable to chrome plating operations and environmental compliance
* Understanding of production process flow and efficiency optimization
* Ability to read and interpret work instructions, schedules, and technical documentation
* Problem-solving skills and attention to detail

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

* Bachelor's (Preferred)
